Une adresse IP identifie une interface ;: An IP address identifies a network interface; a port identifies a service. DNS turns a name into an address. A connection can fail before it reaches the HTTP server. Check each layer to find the cause instead of changing application code at random.

HTTP transporte une méthode, une cible,: HTTP carries a method, a target, headers and sometimes a body. A 4xx code means the request was rejected; 5xx means a server failure. TLS protects the connection and checks the server's identity using certificates. A reverse proxy sends requests to applications.

Script, commandes de test et résultats a: The script, test commands and expected results for failure cases.
Python est utile pour traiter des donnée: Python helps process structured data and call APIs. Separate reading, transforming and writing so each part can be tested. Errors should explain a problem you can act on. Unlimited retries can make an outage worse.
Crée un programme qui lit un inventaire: Read a JSON inventory, check required fields and create a CSV report. Add tests for invalid JSON and an empty file.
Code sans secret, jeu de données fictif: Code without secrets, made-up test data and tests.
Un commit est un état identifié de l’his: A commit is an identified point in history. A branch names a line of work. A pull request lets others discuss and check changes before merging. To resolve a conflict, understand both changes, preserve their purpose and test the result.
Dans ton dépôt de pratique, crée deux br: In a practice repository, make two branches change the same line. Merge them and explain your resolution. Open a pull request with the problem, solution and checks.
Historique lisible, diff et résultat du: A clear history, the diff and a passing test after the merge.
Ignorer un fichier évite de l’ajouter à: Ignoring a file stops it being added later; it does not remove it from history. Revoke any exposed secret. Configuration examples should use fake values. A review checks behaviour, risk, readability and evidence from tests.
Ajoute un .env.example sans identifiants: Add a .env.example without credentials, inspect tracked files and write a review checklist. Simulate a leak using a clearly fake value.
Checklist et procédure de révocation san: A checklist and revocation steps without real credentials.
Une image contient les couches nécessair: An image contains the layers an application needs. A container runs that image in isolation. A multi-stage build separates building from running. A non-root user limits permissions. Pinning a base image helps repeat builds, but you must keep it updated.
Conteneurise une petite application avec: Containerise a small app using .dockerignore, a multi-stage build and a non-root user. Compare its size and behaviour with the original image.
Dockerfile, taille des images et requête: The Dockerfile, image sizes and a successful health check.
Compose décrit plusieurs services et leu: Compose describes services and their dependencies. Services on its network find each other by name. A volume keeps data after a container is replaced; it is not a backup. A database does not need a public port to talk to the application.
Démarre une application et une base avec: Start an app and database with an official Docker example. Save a record, recreate the container, then restore a backup into a test volume.
compose.yaml, preuve de persistance et p: compose.yaml, evidence that data survived and restore instructions.
Un tag est un nom susceptible de changer: A tag is a name that can change. A digest identifies exact content. A registry stores images. Provenance links an image to its code and build. Using the same built artefact across environments reduces surprises.
Construis deux versions locales, compare: Build two local versions and compare their digests. Write promotion and rollback steps. Use a test registry if available.
Table commit → image → digest et procédu: A commit → image → digest table and rollback steps.
GitHub Actions : tests, build et artefac: GitHub Actions: tests, builds and artefacts
Un workflow réagit à un événement. Un jo: A workflow responds to an event. A job runs on a runner with set permissions. Failed tests should fail the pipeline. Artefacts keep the exact build output. Caches speed up dependency downloads but do not replace a build.
Écris un workflow sur pull request avec: Write a pull request workflow with a locked dependency install, lint, tests and a build. Add a deliberately failing test, then fix it.
Fichier YAML et liens vers une exécution: The YAML file and links to one failed and one successful run.
Jenkins, GitLab CI et agents de build: Jenkins, GitLab CI and build agents
Les moteurs de CI partagent des étapes,: CI tools share steps, artefacts and triggers, but use different configuration and runners. Agents execute repository code, so isolation and permissions matter. Never print secrets in logs.
Traduis un pipeline test/build en Jenkin: Write the same test/build pipeline as a Jenkinsfile and .gitlab-ci.yml. Compare triggers, artefacts and secret handling. Run one version in your lab.
Deux configurations commentées et sortie: Two commented configurations and cleaned output from the pipeline you ran.
Une stratégie rolling remplace progressi: Rolling updates replace instances gradually. Blue/green keeps two versions and switches traffic. Canary sends a small share of requests to the new version first. Rolling back application code may not undo an incompatible data migration.
Sur une application locale, prépare deux: Prepare two versions of a local app. Set an error threshold, a health check and a way to return to the previous version.
Chronologie du déploiement, critère d’ar: A deployment timeline, a stop condition and evidence of rollback.

Une région contient des zones de disponi: A region contains availability zones. IAM controls which actions an identity can perform on resources. AWS and the customer share responsibilities depending on the service. Temporary roles are better than permanent keys in pipelines.
Draw an architecture across two zones. Write a read-only policy for a made-up bucket and explain why it cannot write. No paid account is needed.
Schéma, politique JSON fictive et analys: A diagram, a sample JSON policy and a least-privilege explanation.
Un VPC isole un réseau logique. Les tabl: A VPC separates a logical network. Route tables set the next destination; security groups control allowed traffic. A public IP still needs a route and an allowed port. Gateways and data transfers can cost money.
Conçois un réseau application/base, dist: Design an application/database network. Separate public and private subnets and list only the traffic needed. Start with an offline diagram.
Plan d’adressage sans chevauchement, rou: Non-overlapping address ranges, routes and a source/port/destination table.
EC2 propose des machines virtuelles. Un: EC2 provides virtual machines. A load balancer spreads requests and avoids unhealthy targets. Autoscaling adds or removes capacity based on signals. It does not solve every bottleneck. Plan data storage separately from instances.
Compare une VM unique et un groupe multi: Compare one VM with a multi-zone group for a made-up API. Simulate a target failure locally and list the AWS cost categories.
Schéma, résultat du test de panne et hyp: A diagram, failure-test results and sizing assumptions.
S3 stocke des objets ; une base relation: S3 stores objects; relational databases manage relationships and transactions. Versioning helps recover an earlier object, but it is only one part of recovery planning. A backup is useful only when you have tested restoring it.
Classe images, factures et commandes sel: Choose storage for images, invoices and orders. Define retention, private access, RPO and RTO. Restore a made-up local database.
Choix argumentés, script et durée mesuré: Explain your choices, provide the script and measure restore time.
Une fonction répond à un événement sans: A function responds to an event without a server you manage directly. Events may arrive more than once. Idempotent processing avoids duplicate effects. A queue absorbs traffic spikes; a dead-letter queue keeps failed messages.
Programme localement un consommateur qui: Build a local consumer that handles the same event twice without doubling its effect. Add an invalid case and a retry limit.
Code, clé d’idempotence et tests de doub: Code, an idempotency key and tests for duplicates and failures.
La configuration décrit un état souhaité: Configuration describes the desired state. A plan compares it with what exists. Terraform state links resources to their IDs and may hold sensitive data. A shared backend with locking prevents conflicting changes at the same time.
Avec des ressources locales de pratique,: Use local practice resources to run init, validate and plan. Read each proposed change before apply. Explain how to share and back up state.
Configuration, plan expurgé et procédure: Configuration, a cleaned plan and approval steps.
Un module regroupe une configuration ave: A module groups configuration with clear inputs and outputs. Separate development from production to reduce wrong-target mistakes. A variable is not a secret vault. Drift detection compares real resources with declared settings.
Transforme une configuration répétée en: Turn repeated configuration into a module. Make two demo environments, validate their inputs and describe a drift example.
Module, exemples d’utilisation et sépara: A module, usage examples and documented separation of state.
Ansible applique des tâches à un inventa: Ansible runs tasks against an inventory. Modules express an intent, such as installing a package or writing a file. Idempotence means repeating a task keeps the desired result without extra effects. Sensitive variables need dedicated protection.
Configure un service dans une VM de labo: Configure a service on a lab VM with a playbook. Run it twice and compare changes. Move the tasks into a role.
Playbook, inventaire factice et deuxième: A playbook, sample inventory and a second run without unexpected changes.
Un Pod exécute un ou plusieurs conteneur: A Pod runs containers that share a network and volumes. A Deployment maintains replicas and manages their replacement. A Service gives selected Pods a stable address using labels. A namespace organises resources but is not a complete security boundary on its own.
Sur un cluster local, déploie une applic: Deploy an app with two replicas and a Service on a local cluster. Delete one Pod and observe its replacement. Compare direct Pod access with Service access.
Manifestes, événements et preuve du main: Manifests, events and evidence that the replica count is maintained.
Readiness décide si une instance peut re: Readiness decides whether an instance should receive traffic. Liveness decides whether it should restart. Probes that are too strict can worsen an overload. Requests and limits guide scheduling and resource use. Events add context to application logs.
Ajoute readiness, liveness et requests/l: Add readiness, liveness and resource requests/limits. Set a wrong port in your lab, then investigate with describe, events and logs.
Diagnostic écrit, correction minimale et: A written diagnosis, a small fix and evidence of recovery.
RBAC attribue des verbes sur des ressour: RBAC grants actions on resources to an identity. Base64 encoding does not encrypt a Secret. Network policies need a plugin that enforces them. Persistent volumes let data outlive a Pod.
Écris un Role en lecture limitée, une Ne: Write a limited read-only Role, a NetworkPolicy and a volume claim. Explain how to check their effect in a compatible cluster.
Manifestes sans secret réel et matrice d: Manifests without real secrets and a table of allowed and denied access.
Un chart assemble des modèles et valeurs: A chart combines templates and values. Environment settings should make the result clear. Render and validate manifests before installing them. Keeping chart versions helps with rollback.
Crée un petit chart avec image, replicas: Create a small chart with configurable image, replica count and resources. Render two versions and compare their manifests.
Chart, sorties de rendu et justification: The chart, rendered output and reasons for each environment's values.
GitOps utilise Git comme état souhaité e: GitOps keeps desired state in Git. A controller brings the cluster towards that state, making drift visible. Git changes can be reviewed and audited. Limit the controller's access and add safeguards before automatic deletion.
Sur un cluster local, synchronise une ap: Sync a demo app on a local cluster. Change its replica count in Git and watch the controller apply the change.
Commit, états avant/après et procédure p: The commit, before/after states and steps to pause syncing.
Les métriques résument des mesures dans: Metrics summarise measurements over time. Counters go up, gauges rise or fall, and histograms show distributions. Too many label combinations increase data and cost. A useful dashboard answers a clear operational question.
Instrumente taux de requêtes, erreurs et: Measure request rate, errors and latency for a lab API. Show them in Grafana and cause a controlled failure.
Tableau exporté, requêtes et interprétat: An exported dashboard, queries and an explanation of the signals.
Les logs racontent des événements ; les: Logs describe events. Traces connect the steps of a request across services. A correlation ID helps follow one problem. Sampling limits volume. Keep personal details and secrets out of logs.
À partir de la démo OpenTelemetry, suis: Use the OpenTelemetry demo to follow a slow request across services. Write a possible cause and distinguish correlation from proof of cause.
Trace anonymisée, chronologie et prochai: An anonymised trace, a timeline and the next test to narrow the cause.
Un SLI mesure une expérience, par exempl: An SLI measures an experience, such as the share of successful requests. An SLO sets a target over a time window. The error budget is the allowed failure margin. Alerts should call for useful action, not report every change.
Définis un SLI et un SLO pour une API fi: Define an SLI and SLO for a demo API. Calculate its error budget and write an alert with a runbook.
Formule, fenêtre de mesure, calcul et ac: The formula, time window, calculation and expected action.
Pendant un incident, priorité à l’impact: During an incident, focus on impact and recovery. A timeline separates observations from assumptions. A postmortem looks for system factors and clear follow-up actions, without blaming a person. Practise recovery plans.
Organise une panne locale limitée, resta: Cause a small local failure, restore the service and write a postmortem with demo impact, a timeline and three actions you can track.
Runbook testé, durée réelle et actions a: A tested runbook, measured recovery time and actions with success checks.
Un SBOM inventorie les composants. Un sc: An SBOM lists software components. A scanner finds known vulnerabilities but does not prove a product is secure. Set priorities using exposure, exploitability and available fixes. Signatures and provenance help establish where an artefact came from.

Un serveur est un ordinateur qui rend un:
A server is a computer that provides a service: showing a website, keeping files or running an app. Linux organises its work. Think of a building: folders are rooms and files are objects. The terminal lets you ask where you are and what is around you.

pwd shows your current folder. ls lists its contents. cd changes folders. ~ means your home folder. DevOps engineers use these commands to find configuration files and application logs.
Dans ton environnement de pratique autor:

Une permission est une autorisation. Com:
Permissions control access, like keys. Linux separates the owner, group and others. For a file, r allows reading, w editing and x execution. For a folder, x allows entering it and w allows changing its entries when other needed permissions are present.

Before changing permissions, check the owner and the real need. Giving everyone full access can expose files.

Imagine un restaurant : le bâtiment peut:
Imagine a restaurant: the building may be open while the kitchen is closed. A server can be running while its web service is down. A process is a running program. systemd starts and monitors some services. journalctl reads recorded events.

Observe the symptom, gather clues, choose a fix and check the result. Restarting without understanding may only hide the problem.

The cloud means using computing resources provided remotely. Instead of buying a server, you can rent a virtual machine. AWS EC2 lets you start these machines. A region is a geographical area. An instance is a configured virtual machine.

Resources may cost money even when you are not looking at them. A budget alert warns you; it does not guarantee all spending stops.

Never put a secret such as an AWS key in the history. Deleting it from the latest file does not remove old versions.
